completion:
#How to Use a Maintenance Reporting Template

When creating a maintenance report template you will need to:

Identify which features need to be discussed in the report
Find the right metrics to keep track of
Decide who to send the report to and how often

After you have this information you can create the template, then:

Fill out the template as needed
Turn the template into a document and save it
Share the finished product

Note that you’ll likely have to make adjustments to your template over time. You may discover existing issues that require metrics to be better tracked, for example, or discover features that you didn’t think require a discussion at first.

In these cases, you’ll need to look over your template and figure out if changes are needed.<eos>
